primary_meaning: Jesus Christ as the Sun of Righteousness (divine light, glory, and healing presence)

alternatives.meaning: God's glory, protective presence, or everlasting light (sometimes overlapping with Christ)
The Church, Israel, or Mary (as the woman clothed with the sun)
Apocalyptic judgment or cosmic upheaval (via darkening or scorching of the sun)
Idolatry or false worship (condemnation of sun cults)

notes: Christian interpreters most consistently identify the sun with Christ via Malachi's 'Sun of Righteousness' and related light/glory texts; other readings are context-dependent and do not displace the Christological primacy in traditional teaching and symbolism.
